policy: Fill only missing heights, keyed by exact canonical ATP/TML player ID. Each value must be explicitly published by the cited profile source. Existing TML or match-record heights are never overwritten. Values are centimetres rounded to whole centimetres as published or conventionally converted from feet/inches.
